<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <RelativeLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:id="@+id/main" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/white" tools:context=".EditItem">
<!-- Edit Header --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/edit_header" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="16dp" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:background="@color/white">
<!-- Back Button --> <ImageView android:id="@+id/back_button" android:layout_width="24dp" android:layout_height="24dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_back" android:contentDescription="Back"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Edit Item" android:textSize="18sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:paddingStart="16dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Scrollable Content --> <ScrollView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_below="@id/edit_header" android:scrollbars="none">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<!-- Basic Information Card --> <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" app:cardCornerRadius="8dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Basic Information" android:textSize="16sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"/>
<!-- Item Type Dropdown --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Item Type *" android:textSize="14sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<Spinner android:id="@+id/item_type_spinner" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/field_text_box" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"/>
<!-- Item Title --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Item Title *" android:textSize="14sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<EditText android:id="@+id/item_title" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="e.g. Dark Chocolate Cake" android:textSize="14sp" android:background="@drawable/field_text_box" android:inputType="text" android:padding="12dp" android:textColorHint="@android:color/darker_gray" android:textColor="@color/black" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"/>
<!-- Item Category --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Item Category *" android:textSize="14sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<Spinner android:id="@+id/item_category" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/field_text_box" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"/>
<!-- Description --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Description *" android:textSize="14sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<EditText android:id="@+id/item_description" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="120dp" android:hint="Describe the item in detail..." android:textSize="14sp" android:textColorHint="@android:color/darker_gray" android:textColor="@color/black" android:background="@drawable/field_text_box" android:inputType="textMultiLine" android:gravity="top|start" android:padding="12dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<!-- Status Card --> <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" app:cardCornerRadius="8dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Item Status" android:textSize="16sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Status *" android:textSize="14sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<Spinner android:id="@+id/item_status_spinner" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/field_text_box"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="• Active: Item is still lost/found\n• Resolved: Item has been returned/claimed\n• Expired: Posting is no longer active" android:textSize="11sp" android:textColor="@color/text_color" android:layout_marginTop="8dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<!-- Location Card --> <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" app:cardCornerRadius="8dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<ImageView android:layout_width="20dp" android:layout_height="20dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_location" android:contentDescription="Location"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Location" android:textSize="16sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:paddingStart="8dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Location Label --> <TextView android:id="@+id/location_label" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Where did you lose it? *" android:textSize="14sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<EditText android:id="@+id/item_location" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="e.g. Library - 3rd floor" android:textSize="14sp" android:background="@drawable/field_text_box" android:inputType="text" android:padding="12dp" android:textColorHint="@android:color/darker_gray" android:textColor="@color/black"/>
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<!-- Photos Card --> <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" app:cardCornerRadius="8dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<ImageView android:layout_width="20dp" android:layout_height="20dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_photo" android:contentDescription="Photos"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Photos" android:textSize="16sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:paddingStart="8dp"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="2/5 Photos" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="@color/text_color"/>
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Current Photos Display --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Current Photos:" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<!-- Photos Grid RecyclerView --> <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/photos_grid_recyclerview" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:scrollbars="none" android:overScrollMode="never" android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<!-- Action Buttons --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<!-- Delete Button --> <Button android:id="@+id/delete_button" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Delete Item" android:textColor="@color/white" android:backgroundTint="#DC3545" android:textSize="14sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:padding="14dp" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"/>
<!-- Save Button --> <Button android:id="@+id/save_button" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Save Changes" android:textColor="@color/white" android:backgroundTint="@color/blue" android:textSize="14sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:padding="14dp" android:layout_marginStart="8dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>
</RelativeLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:orientation="vertical" android:background="@color/white">
<!-- Top Header --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="16dp" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:background="@color/white">
<!-- Back Button --> <ImageView android:id="@+id/back_button" android:layout_width="24dp" android:layout_height="24dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_back" android:contentDescription="Back"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="My Items" android:textSize="18sp" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Tabs --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingStart="16dp" android:paddingEnd="16dp" android:paddingTop="8dp" android:paddingBottom="8dp" android:gravity="center">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tab_active" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="36dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Active" android:textSize="14sp" android:gravity="center" android:layout_marginEnd="4dp" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp"/>
<TextView android:id="@+id/tab_resolved" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="36dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Resolved" android:textSize="14sp" android:gravity="center" android:layout_marginStart="4dp" android:layout_marginEnd="4dp" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp"/>
<TextView android:id="@+id/tab_expired" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="36dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Expired" android:textSize="14sp" android:gravity="center" android:layout_marginStart="4dp" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Content Area --> <FrameLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent">
<!-- Progress Bar --> <ProgressBar android:id="@+id/progress_bar" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:visibility="gone"/>
<!-- Empty View --> <TextView android:id="@+id/empty_view" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:text="No items found" android:textSize="16sp" android:textColor="@color/text_color" android:visibility="gone"/>
<!-- RecyclerView --> <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/my_items_recyclerview" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:padding="16dp" android:clipToPadding="false"/>
</FrameLayout>
</LinearLayout>
